title: 21st Sitting of second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/21/2/2026).

Question from Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Health, Family and Welfare, Aqeela Ali: President Mohamed Muizzu promised B. Kihaadhoo residents on 13 August 2025 that a health centre extension would be built; why has work not progressed and when will it be completed?

Question from Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Health, Family and Welfare, Aqeela Ali: the President laid the foundation for a new B. Kudarikilu health centre building on 11 August 2025, but no practical work has started since; when will it begin and finish?

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominations for the two Local Government Authority board seats appointed by Parliament (Decentralization Act, Law No. 7/2010, Article 59(a)(2)) are sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the Decentralization Act (Law No. 7/2010), submitted by Thulhaadhoo MP Abdul Hannan Aboobakuru.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Bill on Leasing Uninhabited Islands and Lagoons, submitted on behalf of the government by Thinadhoo North MP Saudhulla Hilmy.

Unfinished business: continued debate on the resolution by Hulhumale South MP Dr Ahmed Shamheed calling on the government to immediately halt the sale of permanent residence permits to foreigners under the "Maldives Pearl Residence Programme" and disclose all related agreements to Parliament.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the health minister on Baa atoll clinics, sent LGA board nominees to committee, and debated the Decentralization amendment, the island-leasing bill and the Pearl Residence resolution.
